value.rationale: Quantifying sensitivity of a natural two-collector ballot event to two-speed coupon heterogeneity is mathematically motivated by the established uniform competition. The new exact positive Catalan-harmonic first derivative and sharp logarithmic fast-group scaling give a meaningful boundary law, beyond the classical degenerate and homogeneous Catalan probabilities; limitations and non-equivalence to the discrete-round problem are explicit.
